description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView for displaying log data in an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView for displaying logs, with methods to initialize views and handle text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
